related.title: Cassandra：tombstone、修復與刪除復活
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用 BFS 找最少邊數路徑，說明它不自動等於最小權重路徑。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use BFS for minimum-edge paths and distinguish them from minimum-weight paths. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 追蹤落後副本錯過刪除後的同步，辨識過早清除 tombstone 的風險。
related.differenceEn: Trace synchronization of a replica that missed a deletion and identify premature tombstone collection risks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無權圖 BFS 依層擴展；有非等權重時需要其他策略，visited 能避免循環反覆擴展。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D；第二檢核：1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

刪除需保留版本化標記讓落後副本知道舊值應消失；回收依修復與保留政策而非立即刪除所有證據。 教學基準：20-10 = 10 deletion versus old-value timestamp gap；第二檢核：2/3*100 = 66.66666667 replicas initially aware of deletion percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: BFS expands unweighted layers; unequal weights need a different strategy and visited sets prevent cyclic re-expansion. Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D; second check: 1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Deletion retains versioned markers so lagging replicas know old values must disappear; collection depends on repair/retention policy. Teaching baseline: 20-10 = 10 deletion versus old-value timestamp gap; second check: 2/3*100 = 66.66666667 replicas initially aware of deletion percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Delta Lake：樂觀並行控制與衝突重算
related.titleEn: Delta Lake: optimistic concurrency and conflict recomputation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用 BFS 找最少邊數路徑，說明它不自動等於最小權重路徑。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use BFS for minimum-edge paths and distinguish them from minimum-weight paths. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 讓兩個writer讀同版資料，檢查commit競爭後何者需重算。
related.differenceEn: Have two writers read one version and determine which must recompute after competing commits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無權圖 BFS 依層擴展；有非等權重時需要其他策略，visited 能避免循環反覆擴展。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D；第二檢核：1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
樂觀並行控制先準備寫入，再驗證讀寫集合與新的表版本；不能把所有append與update視為同樣衝突。 教學基準：100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock；第二檢核：100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D; second check: 1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Optimistic concurrency prepares writes then validates read/write sets against new versions; appends and updates need not conflict identically. Teaching baseline: 100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock; second check: 100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
